limitations: Unannotated replay counts are activity measurements, not precision/recall or instrument identity probabilities.
Defaults are conservative; sparse kick output and overlap rejection can miss real musical attacks.
Overlapping fixed feature windows reject both candidates rather than treating mixture energy as isolated source energy.
Fast bass plucks and struck chords can resemble percussion; the production fixture intentionally demonstrates this ambiguity.
Quiet/smooth ongoing rises can complete later than 50 ms without producing an eligible percussion trigger.
Short FFT masks have finite leakage; changing physical windows changes observed transient features.
